_about: Objective CS-fundamentals items. The Ques document for this section contains open-ended prompts only (kept as written questions); online assessments also test these topics as MCQs.

mcq.q: Which CPU scheduling algorithm can starve long-running processes?
Belady's anomaly (more frames causing more page faults) can occur with which page-replacement algorithm?
What is thrashing?
options: Excessive paging that leaves the CPU mostly idle
A CPU running at full utilisation
Rapid context switching between two threads
mcq.answer: Excessive paging that leaves the CPU mostly idle

mcq.q: A semaphore initialised to 1 and used for mutual exclusion is called:
Which of these is NOT one of the four necessary conditions for deadlock?
What does the fork() system call return in the child process?
Round-robin scheduling with a very large time quantum behaves like:
Which allocation strategy assigns the smallest free block that is large enough?
A process that has terminated but whose exit status has not yet been read by its parent is called:
What is the TLB?
options: A cache of recent virtual-to-physical page translations
mcq.answer: A cache of recent virtual-to-physical page translations

mcq.q: How does a user program request a service from the operating system kernel?
options: By writing to the page table

mcq.q: Which technique addresses priority inversion?
With 4 KB pages, how many bits of a virtual address form the page offset?

w=[sum(b[:i]) for i in range(3)]

mcq.q: Which normal form removes transitive dependencies on the key?
Which isolation level prevents dirty reads but still allows non-repeatable reads?
What does a foreign-key constraint enforce?
Which ACID property guarantees that committed changes survive a crash?
Strict two-phase locking guarantees that schedules are:
Relation R(A, B, C) has key A and functional dependencies A → B and B → C. What is the highest normal form R satisfies?
mcq.explanation: There are no partial dependencies (single-attribute key), but A → C holds transitively through B.

mcq.q: Which SQL isolation level prevents phantom reads?
In a B+ tree index, where are the data entries (or record pointers) stored?
options: Only in the leaf nodes, which are linked together
mcq.answer: Only in the leaf nodes, which are linked together

mcq.q: Which join returns the Cartesian product of two tables?
Why do teams sometimes denormalise a schema?
options: To speed up reads at the cost of redundancy
mcq.answer: To speed up reads at the cost of redundancy

mcq.q: Which OSI layer is responsible for routing packets between networks?
Which protocol resolves an IPv4 address to a MAC address on a local network?
What is the default port for HTTPS?
How many usable host addresses does an IPv4 /26 subnet provide?
Standard DNS queries are usually carried over:

What is the sequence of TCP's three-way handshake?
Which HTTP version introduced multiplexing many request streams over a single TCP connection?
What is Network Address Translation (NAT) mainly used for?
options: Mapping private IP addresses to a public IP address
mcq.answer: Mapping private IP addresses to a public IP address

mcq.q: Which TCP mechanism stops a fast sender from overwhelming a slow receiver?
options: Flow control using the receive window
mcq.answer: Flow control using the receive window

mcq.q: What does the TTL field in an IP header prevent?
options: Packets circulating forever in a routing loop
mcq.answer: Packets circulating forever in a routing loop

mcq.q: Which protocol automatically assigns IP addresses to hosts on a network?
How does a client verify a server's identity during a TLS handshake?
options: By validating the server's certificate chain against trusted certificate authorities
By checking the server's IP address range
mcq.answer: By validating the server's certificate chain against trusted certificate authorities

mcq.q: Which principle lets a subclass object be used wherever its superclass is expected?

mcq.q: Which cache mapping lets a memory block be placed in any cache line?

The CPU to run two programs at once

mcq.q: Which compiler phase converts source text into tokens?

Compiling the whole program before distribution
